title: Linear Regression with Gradient Descent
signature: def linear_regression_gd(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, lr: float, n_iters: int) -> tuple
hints: Start from w = 0 and b = 0, then repeat the same update n_iters times.
The residual r = Xw + b - y drives both gradients: dw = (2/n) X^T r and db = (2/n) sum(r).
Compute both gradients from the same residual before you update either parameter.
